## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: floods, fog, snow and ice, headlights, night driving and wrong-way drivers
Knowledge facts: part C holds 57 fact blocks (sec17-F01 onward) from physical pages 56 to 58; part C2 holds 12 confusable blocks (sec17-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A names the issuer, the September 2026 revision line and the written-test requirement; question count, passing standard, format and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- AZ-NIGHT-A-COUNT — written-test question count not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- AZ-NIGHT-A-PASS — passing standard not printed; nothing shown to learners (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- AZ-NIGHT-A-FORMAT — item format not printed (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-NIGHT-A-TIME — time limit not printed (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-NIGHT-A-EDITION — issuer current-edition confirmation pending; issuer page was bot-challenged at intake (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-NIGHT-D-ROUTES — example divided highways in the wrong-way tips (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-NIGHT-E-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- AZ-NIGHT-ETWO-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: the flood-response liability rule is statutory and can be amended (for example sec17-F12), and the overhead wrong-way alert system can change (for example sec17-F54).
Index: exam authority in A; audience in B; knowledge facts with misconceptions, mnemonics, glossary and dynamic-fact lines in C; confusables in C2; accuracy in D; market in E and E2; definition-of-done matrix in G.
